vb_textbox.text: The best way of accumulating points is switching between the gnome on the right and the gnome on the left, round by round. (e.g. game 1 - left gnome, game 2 - right gnome, game 3 - left gnome, and so on). When one of the choices receives a low number of mushrooms, or no mushrooms, switch the way you do it, so if you choose the right gnome and it results in low/no mushrooms, choose the right gnome again in the next round.TLDR: Alternate between the left and right gnome, if low/no mushrooms, repeat the same gnome on the next round.
